-- Let me try using a different format. Let me check what strftime works in DuckDB.
WITH all_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions
),
month_starts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT date_trunc('month', txn_date::DATE) as month_start
    FROM customer_transactions
),
cumulative_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_id,
        m.month_start,
        COALESCE(SUM(
            CASE WHEN t.txn_type = 'deposit' THEN t.txn_amount 
                 WHEN t.txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -t.txn_amount 
                 WHEN t.txn_type = 'purchase' THEN -t.txn_amount 
                 ELSE 0 END), 0) as balance
    FROM all_customers c
    CROSS JOIN month_starts m
    LEFT JOIN customer_transactions t ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id 
        AND t.txn_date::DATE <= m.month_start
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, m.month_start
),
month_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        month_start,
        SUM(CASE WHEN balance < 0 THEN 0 ELSE balance END) as total_balance
    FROM cumulative_balance
    GROUP BY month_start
)
SELECT 
    CAST(month_start AS DATE)::VARCHAR as month,
    total_balance
FROM month_totals
WHERE month_start > (SELECT MIN(month_start) FROM month_totals)
ORDER BY month ASC;
